Sets Quartz AG Grid theme variables and styles for layout, icons, menus, filters, and rows.

# Purpose
This stylesheet defines the visual rules for the `ag-grid` Quartz themes, including `ag-theme-quartz`, `ag-theme-quartz-dark`, and `ag-theme-quartz-auto-dark`. It sets CSS custom properties and layout values for grid parts such as filter panels, tool panels, headers, inputs, checkboxes, radio buttons, detail rows, menus, dialogs, charts, and table rows. The file also maps `ag-icon-*` classes to font codes and image fallbacks so the grid can show the correct symbols for actions such as sorting, filtering, paging, and selection. It also handles left-to-right and right-to-left display modes by changing margins and padding, and the `_grid_9qncm_1` class sets theme variables for background, header, and text colors used by the application.
